description: JavaScript source file implementing AJAX UI functionalities for SuiteCRM, including content loading, error handling, and UI updates.

methods.name: callback
methods.description: Handles AJAX response, updates UI content, title, favicon, and module tabs.

methods.name: showErrorMessage
methods.description: Displays an error message in a modal panel with iframe content.

methods.name: canAjaxLoadModule
methods.description: Determines if a module can be loaded via AJAX based on configuration and license state.

methods.name: loadContent
methods.description: Loads content into the UI via AJAX, with URL validation and history management.

methods.name: go
methods.description: Navigates to a URL, using AJAX if possible, with history and module checks.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Submits a form via AJAX, with global cleanup and fallback to normal submission.

methods.name: cleanGlobals
methods.description: Resets global variables and instances related to the UI.

methods.name: firstLoad
methods.description: Initializes the AJAX UI state based on bookmarked URL or default.

methods.name: print
methods.description: Opens a print window for the current AJAX UI content.

methods.name: showLoadingPanel
methods.description: Displays a loading indicator during AJAX operations.

methods.name: setFavicon
methods.description: Updates the page favicon based on provided data.
